Build succeeded with zero errors. Here's what was created:

**Project: `RecipeCommunity`** (Blazor Web App, .NET 11, Server interactivity)

**Structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — `Recipe`, `RecipeSubmission`, `CategoryInfo` models
- `Services/RecipeService.cs` — singleton service with 8 seed recipes across 4 categories
- `Components/Pages/Home.razor` — homepage showing category cards (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/Category.razor` — lists recipes in a category with star previews (static SSR)
- `Components/Pages/RecipeDetail.razor` — full recipe with ingredients/steps + interactive `StarRating` widget
- `Components/Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` — interactive form (title, category, ingredients, steps)
- `Components/StarRating.razor` — click-to-rate 1–5 stars widget with hover effects

**Key design decisions:**
- Most pages render as **static SSR** (read-only content) — no SignalR overhead
- Only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `@rendermode InteractiveServer` for click handling
- `RecipeService` is registered as a **singleton** so ratings and submissions persist in memory
- Nav sidebar links to all 4 categories + submit page
